svg.title: Qist favicon 16
svg.desc: Symbol only, small-size variant, per the floor rule: no wordmark below a 32px symbol, and the master drawing is not used below 32px. Full bleed — the mark renders at 16px, the tile size, with no extra inset, because the 120 artboard already carries its own padding: the ink fills 0.75 of it, so 12.00px of ink sits inside a 16px tile and the 8-unit stroke computes to 1.07px. Tile is ink-900 #141414 at radius 2.0, 12.5% of the tile in both sizes, so the two favicons match each other and the mark holds on light and dark browser chrome.
